## Description

Please include a summary of the change and which issue it fixes. Describe the motivation and context for changes.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Data update/correction (adding or updating dataset records)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)

## Verification Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code
- [ ] I have verified locally using `npm run lint` and `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] I have tested new or updated endpoints locally
- [ ] New/updated data includes credible source attribution
